name: werkstoff
description: My personal Claude Code plugin workshop.

plugins.name: self-assess
plugins.description: Self-assessment for live, actively-maintained codebases: import-graph-based stage/wire mapping, docs-vs-code drift detection, CI/CD topology audit, house-rules convention enforcement, code-idiom/architecture-deficiency detection, and a multi-repo portfolio dashboard — almost entirely read-only, writes only to a scoped output directory (default analysis/self-assess/**, configurable), with two narrowly-gated, off-by-default Edit exceptions (self-assess-transform-execute, self-assess-idiom-fix) for applying already-authorized findings.

plugins.name: confab
plugins.description: AI-generated-code quality auditing for live, actively-maintained codebases: dependency-hallucination detection, LLM-reasoned assertion/mutation strength auditing, machine-checkable contract-drift detection, self-referential agentic-loop reliability auditing, plus preflight and status meta-skills, a diff-scoped pre-commit variant (confab-code-change), and a bounded autonomous self-optimization cycle (confab-cycle) with a persistent ledger and an opt-in propose/fix mode — read-only except a scoped output directory, one skill (confab-dependency-audit) with read-only network egress to public package registries, and one skill (confab-cycle, fix mode only) with narrowly-scoped Edit access to apply and re-verify dependency/contract-drift/agentic-reliability fixes.

plugins.name: compass
plugins.description: A Claude-Code-native reasoning-composition plugin for complex/vague tasks: 13 skills grounded in prompt-engineering techniques from universal-creator (clarify-scope, explore-branches, decompose-chain, reason-verify, ground-evidence, draft-revise, calibrate-format, optimize-instruction, investigate-dynamically, map-relationships, negotiate-tradeoffs, verify-assumptions, summarize-trace), composed by compass-solve into an actual workflow rather than exposed as a technique picker.

plugins.name: cupertino
plugins.description: A Steve-Jobs-grounded design and craft discipline for a project's whole lifecycle, not just UI polish: 10 skills, each grounded in a specific, real Jobs/Apple decision (the 1997 return-to-Apple product-line cut, NeXTSTEP-to-Apple-Silicon's unbroken lineage, Alan Kay's whole-widget line, iPhone/iPod foam-core prototyping, Time Machine's transfiguration of backup, iPhone/iPad unboxing-as-theater, the iPhone cannibalizing the iPod), composed by cupertino-review into one fixed lifecycle pipeline rather than exposed as a technique picker. A second, self-contained handbook lifecycle (draft/apply/check/fix, domain-parameterized across design/code/testing/documentation) persists a project's actual conventions into a durable artifact and re-checks new work against it, with no dependency on other plugins.

plugins.name: andon
plugins.description: Evidence-grounded harden-and-advance loop for live, actively-maintained codebases: propose maximally from the code/artifacts/best-practice, verify adversarially against evidence rather than authority across seven proof strategies chosen by wire type, and advance only past a proven wire (the andon rule) — never past a broken or unproven one. Composable skill family (preflight, propose, verify, loop, status) over a native OKF ledger, read-only except a scoped output directory.

plugins.name: cli-scaffold
plugins.description: Scaffolds production-grade CLI apps across 12 languages (Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Ruby, PHP, Perl, .NET, Rust, Go, Bash, Zsh, PowerShell, POSIX sh), grouped into three paradigm skills (compiled, interpreted, shell) plus a shared architecture doctrine and a front-door orchestrator. Generation is freeform every time — no stored boilerplate — guided strictly by five pillars: UX/discoverability, backend/core separation, stability (frozen exit-code contract, snapshot-tested --help), idiomatic per-ecosystem distribution, and Unix composability. A read-only verifier agent checks generated output against the doctrine before it's presented.

plugins.name: codebase-consistency
plugins.description: Harmonize an already-modern, live codebase that grew inconsistent — divergent architecture, docs, code patterns, and style across modules — with a structured preflight / scan / map / canonize / brief / align / verify / status workflow. Derives the canonical form for undocumented, non-deprecated pattern variants (documented conventions and version-deprecated idioms are out of scope — see self-assess); an interactive consistency matrix; specialist agents; and optional dynamic-workflow orchestration with adversarial verification.

plugins.name: takt
plugins.description: Enforces declared beat order at the tool-call layer: denies an edit or a dispatch that runs ahead of the step it depends on, so cross-plugin sequencing is a runtime gate rather than a sentence a model may skip. Inert until a repository declares its beats.

plugins.name: lehre
plugins.description: Researches a code style, pattern and architecture doctrine from external authority plus real repository evidence, then enforces it at the tool-call layer: a blocking rule denies the write that would violate it, quoting its own rationale, rather than describing the violation after the fact. Works from a blank page as well as over an existing tree — greenfield project initialization is decomposed into units and seams, and a write into a unit whose dependencies are not yet validated is denied just as a rule violation is. Nine skills spanning evaluate / research / investigate / suggest / implement / validate / test, eight agents, one PreToolUse hook, and a closed deterministic check vocabulary (fnmatch and Python ast, never regex) whose enforcement tier is derived from the check kind rather than declared — so a rule cannot claim to block and silently fail to. Inert until a repository declares a doctrine.

plugins.name: nacharbeit
plugins.description: Reworks a Claude Code plugin to the official Anthropic standard the way a failed part is reworked to spec: a calibrated review of its skills, agents, commands, workflow prompts, hooks, scripts, report viewers, manifest, README and the developer docs that wire it in, then a tier-gated fix pass that applies only what a haiku or sonnet remediator can do without judgement, blind-verified, under a PreToolUse hook that denies every edit outside the fix lock. Nothing is graded until the finder passes a sealed hold-out; opus- and human-tier findings are surfaced, never auto-applied. Read-only except analysis/nacharbeit/ and, during a fix pass, the files its lock names.

plugins.name: matrize
plugins.description: Derives a named, platform-neutral design system from reference exemplars and emits it to any target. Measurement and interpretation stay separate artefacts rather than separate sections: decode records what each reference actually shows, graded for how far its values can be trusted and what rights its source carries, while name interprets — every recurring element gets a purpose, a rule and an anti-rule, and a rule with no stated failure case is not emitted at all. The source of truth is a DTCG token file, never CSS; CSS, a VitePress theme layer and the landscape sketchbook are formatter output run by committed scripts, so the same tokens regenerate byte-stable. References are read-only, enforced by a PreToolUse hook rather than by convention, so values and rules may be extracted while assets are never copied. Every fan-out agent is read-only; writes are confined to the configured design root's system/ and out/ directories.

plugins.name: arbeitsplan
plugins.description: Compiles a stated problem into an executable, budgeted agentic workflow, runs it as a redundant swarm — N candidates over the SAME scope in their own git worktrees, judged blind, exactly one landed and the rest deleted — and refuses to converge by retrying. Ordering is delegated to takt via a generated beat declaration rather than enforced twice. Writes to a scoped output directory (analysis/arbeitsplan/**), to candidate worktrees under .arbeitsplan/**, and — only behind an explicit approval gate — to .claude/takt.local.md; the single landing step is the one place it touches the working tree. A PreToolUse hook denies an identical re-dispatch, an out-of-scope write, a shared-tree write during a fan-out, and a dispatch past the declared budget. Ships a headless `claude -p` matrix runner for sweeps that need a fresh process and a real per-cell --model.
